tickets.recommended_action: Have rotating-equipment specialist diagnose NDE vibration today; correct per findings and verify stable vibration below alarm. Diagnose vibration mechanism. Obtain current vibration trend. Obtain source-required attention today.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the sole main gas export compressor has no spare or workaround and would cause recycle and production curtailment within an hour.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first test start, then started after 8 s and reached rated pressure; 22.8 V at rest and recurrent starting issues undermine firewater demand reliability, while partner delivery capability is uncertain.
tickets.recommended_action: Diagnose batteries, starting air and circuits; repair under fire-protection authority and retest start and rated pressure. Check impairment deviation record. Test FW-8101 pressure and flow capacity. Verify reliable start restoration.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A required start attempt failed during a function test. The later start and normal rated-pressure run confirm delivery once running but not reliable starting on demand.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of this safety-critical firewater pump creates severe major-accident protection exposure. The N+1 partner cannot be fully credited because its later test showed 9.2 barg versus 11 barg with flow unmeasured, though it did start.

tickets.summary: PL-1002 has wet-CUI wall loss to 6.2 mm versus 7.4 mm minimum at the low-point drain; containment loss is unconfirmed, but the line carries hydrocarbons at full wellhead pressure.
tickets.recommended_action: Integrity engineer to assess/isolate, extend UT around the low point, approve repair, then leak-test to the approved criterion. Confirm current state and repair status. Extend UT and calculate remaining life. Verify occupancy and release escalation.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this non-redundant production flowline could release hydrocarbons at full wellhead pressure, creating extreme personnel and escalation consequences.

tickets.recommended_action: Authorized lifting inspector to inspect the full rope, lubricate, repair/replace as required, then verify hoist performance and rope criterion. Check lift loads and personnel exposure. Confirm current rope and repair status.

tickets.summary: P-3305 has tripped three times this month, causing intermittent inhibitor injection for ~10 days; the suspected diaphragm fault risks delayed downstream carbon-steel corrosion.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of inhibitor does not stop production, but starvation initiates downstream carbon-steel corrosion within weeks and creates a delayed integrity consequence; no redundant pump is identified.

tickets.recommended_action: Barricade drop zone; inspect and securely refit or replace loose lagging/cladding, then verify all fastenings. Check drop-zone personnel exposure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Secure attachment has already failed, and the observation states the section will become a dropped object if left.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Complete detachment creates a credible dropped-object hazard; personnel exposure beneath the line is not established, so a broader severe consequence is unsupported.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v3: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=9, I=5, base=7, final=7. P-SAFETY-UNKNOWN (precautionary_policy): Occupancy, access and potential strike exposure beneath the loose cladding are unknown and could change the dropped-object consequence assessment.
